name: What materials are typically used for custom built-ins?

mainEntity.name: What materials are typically used for custom built-ins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for custom built-ins include various types of wood (e.g., maple, oak, cherry), plywood, MDF (medium-density fiberboard), and laminates. The choice of material often impacts durability, appearance, and cost. For instance, solid wood offers a premium look and feel but is generally more expensive than MDF with a veneer, which can still achieve a refined finish at a lower price point.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom built-ins use materials like solid wood, plywood, MDF, and laminates, with choices affecting durability, appearance, and cost.
